pages.title: Coach home (redirect)
pages.where: Not a page coaches open. Going to the coach home address sends them straight to Academy (Community).
pages.summary: It only checks who is signed in and then sends the coach on to the Academy community page.
pages.notes: The screen only shows "Redirecting…" for a moment. If the coach record is missing, it shows an error asking an admin to set it up. Admins who are not viewing as a coach are sent to the admin community page instead.

pages.title: Classroom
pages.where: Academy → Classroom
pages.summary: Browse the training courses, see how far you are through each one, and open a lesson.
controls: Course cards at the top (Start Here, Coach Action Plan, Going Pro, Get Calls, Win Clients, Coach Clients), each with a label like Onboarding, Strategy, Foundations, Marketing, Sales or Delivery
Progress bar on each course card, showing "X of Y complete" or the number of lessons
**The Portfolio System** banner under the course cards, with a map preview; click it to open the map
**The Vault** section at the bottom, with the blurb "Extra courses: books, talks and how-tos."
**Show** / **Hide** arrow strip on The Vault to open or close it
Vault course cards: StryvX (Personal growth), Books (Book summaries), How-to (Tools & set-up)
Row of single video talks under the Vault courses, each with its length and the speaker's name
pages.notes: Clicking a course card opens its first lesson. The Vault starts closed for new coaches and opens by itself once you have started a Vault lesson; the page remembers Show or Hide on that device. The Vault talks row only appears if talks are available.Draft lessons are hidden from coaches.

pages.title: Classroom course (entry redirect)
pages.where: Academy → Classroom, then pick a course
pages.summary: This page shows nothing itself; it sends the coach straight to the first lesson of the chosen course, or back to the Classroom list if the course is retired or has no lessons.
pages.notes: Coaches never see this page as a screen because it always redirects. Ava should point them to the Classroom lesson page they land on instead. An unknown course shows a not-found page.

pages.title: System
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → System (the lead-flow map; open Academy in the sidebar, go to Classroom, then choose the system map)
pages.summary: See the whole path from finding ideal clients to keeping them as a map, hover or click any step to read about it, and open the matching lesson.
controls: **Classroom** link at top left, goes back to the Classroom
Step 1 box **Find Your Ideal Clients** with cards **Choose Your Ideal Client**, **Define the Problem You Solve**, **Build Your Prospect List**
Step 2 box **Set Up Your Pipeline** with cards **Optimise Your LinkedIn Profile**, **Create Your Lead Capture**, **Set Up Your Call Booking**
Step 3 box **Lead Generation & Win Clients** with the flow map (Prospect Lists, Interest Sequence, Reply Sequence, Discovery Call, Value Session, New Client and the Yes/No questions)
**Customise funnel** button in the step 3 header opens a panel
Sliders **Reachable**, **Interested**, **Booked**, **Qualified**, **Won** in the funnel panel
**New clients** box with minus and plus buttons (1 to 50) in the funnel panel
**Reset** and close (X) buttons in the funnel panel
Step 4 box **Build Authority** with cards **Run Your Newsletter**, **Email Your List**, **Post on Social**
Step 5 box **Keep Clients** with cards **Onboard New Clients**, **Deliver Coaching**, **Retain & Renew**
**Open lesson** button in the pop-up when you hover a card or map step
**Close** button in the detail box that opens when you click a map step
Small info (i) icon on each step header shows what that step is for
pages.notes: Hovering a card or map step shows a pop-up with details; clicking a map step opens a detail box below the map. The newsletter, email list and social cards say "Lesson coming soon." and have no link. Funnel settings are saved in the coach's browser only.

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → This Week's Focus
pages.summary: Read this week's focus and action, listen to the audio, and look back at past weeks.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top, goes back to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** label above the title (shows **Past Focus** when viewing an older week)
**This week’s action** box with the one thing to do
**Listen** audio player, shown only when the week has audio
Lesson text under the action box, shown only when the week has text
**Open** button at the bottom, named after the related learning path (e.g. "Open [path name]")
**Back to this week** button, shown only when viewing a past week
**Past weeks** list, each row has its week number, path, title, action and an **Open** link
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text load a moment after the page and only appear if that week has them. The **Past weeks** list only shows once there are earlier weeks. Weekly Focus is not in the main sidebar; coaches reach it from the Classroom.

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → open a Weekly Focus week
pages.summary: Read one week's focus, its action, and any audio or lesson text, then jump to the related learning path or go back to earlier weeks.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top, goes back to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** or **Past Focus** label above the title, showing which kind of week it is
**This week’s action** box with the task for the week
**Listen** audio player, shown only when the week has audio
Lesson text below the action, shown only when the week has lesson text
**Open** button at the bottom, named after the related path (for example "Open [path name]"), goes to that learning path
**Back to this week** button, shown only on a past week
**Past weeks** list with each week's number, path, title and action, each with an **Open** link
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text load after the page opens, so they may appear a moment later or not at all if the week has none. The **Past weeks** list only appears once there are past weeks.

pages.title: The Resource Library
pages.where: Academy → Resources
pages.summary: Browse, search and open every guide, sheet, deck and template for winning clients, running sessions and using the Profit System.
controls: **Search inside every resource** box at the top of the page, which looks inside the pages as well as the titles
**Show only** filter buttons: **All**, **Docs**, **Sheets**, **Slides**, **Files**, **Videos**, **Reading**, each with a count
**Get clients** section, which opens to show its resources
**Keep clients** section, which opens to show its resources
**Profit System** section, which opens to show resources in three columns: Vision, Velocity and Value
**Search inside resources** box in the contents list on the left
**Overview** link in the contents list, which returns to this page
**Contents** button on a phone, which opens and closes the contents list
**Collapse contents** / **Expand contents** button on a computer, which shrinks or opens the left list
**The old Resources list** link at the bottom of the contents list
pages.notes: Searching or picking a type filter replaces the three sections with a list of matching resources. Clicking a resource opens its own page. Searching inside pages works only once the page text has loaded after sign-in, so results can take a moment.

pages.title: Resource page
pages.where: Academy → Resources → open any resource
pages.summary: Read one resource from the library, and copy, download or open its sheets, slides and files.
controls: **Watch the lesson** button at the top (only on pages with a lesson)
**Download PDF** button at the top (only on pages with a written document)
**Make a copy** button on a Google Sheet or Slides card
**View the master** button on a Google Sheet card
**Open** button on a Slides card
**Download** button on a file card
**Open in Drive** button on a file card
**How to run it** link beside a group of sheet tabs
**Watch the video** button when a video can't play on the page
**Previous** and **Next** links at the bottom, which step through the whole library
pages.notes: The page shows "Loading…" first, and if it fails it says "This resource didn't load. Sign in again, or refresh the page." What each page contains varies, so only some of these buttons appear on any one page. Some reading links carry a warning note, and broken links are shown crossed out.

pages.title: Resource list
pages.where: Academy → Resources → ← The Resource Library link leads to the Resource Library; this older list page is reached from there
pages.summary: Browse or search the original list of Academy resource links, grouped by area, and open any of them in a new tab.

tabs.label: Area switch (buttons at the top; names come from the app and are not shown in the page code)

controls: **← The Resource Library** link at the top, goes back to the Resource Library page
Area buttons in a row at the top, the first area is open by default
**Search resources…** box, searches title, topic, link and section name across all areas
Count line, e.g. "12 resources in" the chosen area
Section headings that open and close with a click, with a number showing how many resources are inside
Topic headings inside sections that also open and close
Document groups with a note "One file · each link opens a different tab or sheet"
**Open full document** link inside a document group
Table columns **Resource** and **Type** (search results also show **Topic**)
Resource title links that open in a new tab
**No resources match your search.** message when a search finds nothing
pages.notes: This is the old link list, kept while the Resource Library is being tested. The trash icon and the "Admin mode" note are admin-only, so coaches never see them and Ava must not offer deleting. I could not confirm the exact area button names or the exact sidebar route to this page from the code.

pages.title: Ava
pages.where: Not in the sidebar lists given; the page opens at /coach/ava (Ava is the assistant inside the app).
pages.summary: The coach opens the full Ava page to chat with Ava, the app's AI assistant.
pages.notes: The page code only loads the main Ava screen, so its buttons and fields are not shown here. Ava should not describe specific labels on this page beyond saying it is the full-page chat with her.

pages.title: My Blueprint
pages.where: My Blueprint (sidebar)
pages.summary: See your Blueprint overview: a setup checklist, every Blueprint page with its status, and what is waiting on you.
controls: **Your Blueprint** heading with a **?** button (How your Blueprint works) that opens a pop-up
**Where you are** in the pop-up: three steps, the first opens a call with Ava
**Why we build it for you** video in the pop-up
**How status works** in the pop-up: the five statuses with page counts
**List** / **Board** switch (top right of the heading) to show pages as rows or as cards by status
Setup checklist under the intro text
Contents list: each page with its icon, short description, chat count or **new** badge, and a status pill
Click any page row to open that page
Board columns by status, each showing a count; **Needs you** folds to a thin strip when empty
Page cards on the Board, with chat count and short description
pages.notes: The Blueprint pages are built from your answers, and the page chat is on the right of each page. The Checklist/Timeline switch, Ava's drafts, Release and the Launch back button are admin-only, so never offer them. Pages BCA builds look quieter until you have answered your own cards.

pages.title: One Blueprint page
pages.where: My Blueprint → pick a page from the contents list
pages.summary: Read one page of your practice plan on its own, with the same content as the full Blueprint.
controls: **Parts of this page** row of buttons at the top, on pages made of parts such as About you, to jump to each part (ticked once done)
**How to do it, in the Classroom** box at the bottom with links to Classroom lessons
**Still needed from you** list, if shown in the Blueprint layout around the page
**Talk it through** button that opens Ava
**Download** button, if shown in the Blueprint layout, with **Whole blueprint for your AI**, **Just this page** and **Save as PDF**
**Edit** button on the Decision page (shown only to BCA admins)
pages.notes: Which page opens depends on the page name in the link, and the Blueprint overview and Command Center pages do not open here. Lead lists shows the lists built for you, or a message that they are still being built. Ava's plan, plan again and import controls on the lead lists page and the Edit button on the Decision page are for BCA admins only, so never offer them to coaches.}

pages.title: Blueprint (whole document)
pages.where: My Blueprint → Blueprint
pages.summary: Read your whole Practice Blueprint as one long document, see what BCA still needs from you, and jump to any chapter or page.
controls: **Your Portfolio Blueprint** cover at the top with a welcome video from Zander (**Why we build it for you**)
**Still needed from you** box listing what you still need to answer, each item linking to its page
**Talk it through** button in that box, opens Ava
**Contents** list of numbered chapters, each with links to its pages
Every chapter shown in full below the contents, with the pages and parts inside it
**How to do it, in the Classroom** links at the bottom of pages that have them
Parts links at the top of a page made of parts, ticked once nothing is left for you to answer
**Decision Record** page shows what BCA proposes, marked **Proposed by BCA** or **Agreed**
**Lead lists** page shows the lists built for you and how each one searches LinkedIn
pages.notes: The **Still needed from you** box only shows while something is missing. The **Write my blueprint** bar, the **Edit** button on the Decision Record and Ava's plan on Lead lists are for BCA admins only, so never offer them to coaches. The document says where a number is missing instead of inventing one.}

pages.title: Your plan (jobs view)
pages.where: Not reachable by coaches. My Blueprint is the sidebar item at /coach/blueprint, and this page sends coaches back there.
pages.summary: A new admin-only jobs list that shows the Blueprint as a list or board of launch jobs; coaches are sent back to My Blueprint.
pages.notes: The whole page is admin-only for now: anyone who is not an admin is redirected to My Blueprint and sees nothing here. Ava should never send a coach to this page or describe its list, board or job chats.

pages.title: BOSS Score
pages.where: Keep Clients → BOSS Score
pages.summary: Pick a client or prospect, or add someone new, and score their business together on the BOSS grid to see their results, charts and insights.
controls: **Choose someone from the list** picker at the top, to open an existing client or prospect
**+ Add new person** option in the picker, with name, job title and business fields
**Start session** button to begin scoring a new person
**Change session** and **View scorecard** options in the session menu at the top right once someone is chosen
**Copy client dashboard link** option in the same menu, to share the client's own page
**Areas** grid where you click scores for each playbook (scores save on their own and show a **Scores saved.** message)
**Owner level completeness** card with a bar for each level
**BOSS wheel** card showing the area scores
**Insights** card with the tabs **Overview**, **Levels**, **Pillars** and **Areas**
Round **refresh** button in the Insights card header to rebuild insights
**See full overview** button under the Overview insight, with a **Top 3 Priorities** list
**Charts** section with **Score breakdown** and **Your focus areas**, shown when the grid is not in live scoring
pages.notes: The page title on screen is Keep Clients, and the grid is empty and faded until a person is chosen and the session started. The Boss Pro page can also open full-screen without the sidebar. Admin-only parts are the coach picker when adding a person, the all-coaches contact list and the prospect priority matrix, so never offer them to coaches.}

pages.title: Calls
pages.where: Win Clients → Calls
pages.summary: See your booked sales calls in a calendar or list, mark how each call went, add a call for a prospect, and set up your booking calendars.
controls: **Search calls…** box at the top left
**Filter** button: in calendar view pick calendars and a type; in list view pick Timing and Call status
**Sort** button (list view only): Sort by Call time, Date added, Prospect or Call status, plus Order
**Settings** button: opens your booking calendars, weekly hours and calendar provider
**Calendar view** and **List view** icon buttons to switch views
**Add a call** button: choose a prospect (search box), then pick a calendar and time and press **Confirm**
Calendar view: **Today**, previous and next arrows, and **Day** / **Week** / **Month** switch, with a colour key (Confirmed, Completed, No-show, Cancelled, Imported)
Click a call to see its details: **Join meeting**, **Watch recording**, status buttons and **Open contact** (or **Close**)
List view columns: Prospect, Contact info, Date added, Call time, Calendar, Call status (change the status in the drop-down in each row)
In Settings: **Booking calendars** list with an on/off switch, copy booking link button and Edit/Delete menu, plus **New calendar** button
In Settings: **Weekly hours** box with **Timezone** and **Save hours** button
In Settings: **Connect calendar** for Google or Outlook, and the **Calendar provider** drop-down (Profit Coach calendars or CRM calendar)
Settings: **Calls** link at the top goes back to your calls
CRM calendar fields: **CRM profile name**, **CRM location ID**, **Booking calendar embed**, **Lead webhook URL**, **Save CRM details**
pages.notes: Clicking a call row opens the client's page only if the coach has client hub access. The calendar can show Google or Outlook events once connected in Settings, but bookings work without it. The CRM fields only appear when Calendar provider is set to CRM calendar.The Coach filter and Coach column are admin-only, so never offer them.

pages.title: Campaigns
pages.where: Get Calls → Campaigns
pages.summary: See how your outreach campaigns are doing, turn them on or off, and create new ones.
controls: **Connect LinkedIn** link at the top right, shown until LinkedIn is connected
**Settings** button at the top right, shown once LinkedIn is connected (opens sending settings)
**Create campaign** button at the top right (opens a pop-up with **Name**, a **Channel** choice of LinkedIn, Email or WhatsApp, then **Blank** or **Templates**)
**Activity this** chart with arrows (**Previous period**, **Next period**) and a range dropdown, plus tiles **People reached**, **Planned remaining**, **Connect rate**, **Replies**
Campaigns table with columns **Campaign**, **Via**, **Connect**, **Replies**; each row has an On/Off switch and a drag handle to reorder
Click a campaign row to open that campaign
Three-dot **Campaign actions** menu on each row: **Edit**, **Duplicate**, **Archive** (or **Unarchive**), **Delete**
**Archived** bar under the table, opens the list of archived campaigns
Activity list on the right showing each lead's Status and Next step
**Connect LinkedIn** card on the right, with your Social Selling Index and pending invites once connected
pages.notes: LinkedIn must be connected before a LinkedIn campaign can be switched on; email campaigns need Gmail or Outlook and WhatsApp campaigns need WhatsApp connected. Templates are only for LinkedIn campaigns. A floating Sample data switch shows only for staff or the demo coach, so never offer it to coaches. The Lead Lists and Lead Magnets tabs open from the same Get Calls tab row.

pages.title: One campaign
pages.where: Get Calls → Campaigns, then click a campaign

controls: **← Campaigns** link at the top, back to the campaigns list
**On/Off switch** next to the campaign name, turns the campaign on or off
**Pencil (Edit campaign name)** next to the name, rename the campaign
**Settings** button at the top right, opens campaign settings (including archive and delete)
**By status** card on Overview, click a status to see the people in it, **View all** goes to Prospects
**Add prospects** button on Overview, add people to this campaign
**Conversion** card on Overview, shows rates such as Connect rate, Interest rate or Reply rate
**Daily activity** chart on Overview, shows Invites sent, Accepted, Messages and Engagement
**Set up steps** / **Review steps** button on an empty Overview, opens the Steps tab
**Already in the system**, **Add one person**, **Sales Navigator**, **Google Maps**, **Google Search**, **Upload CSV** choices when adding people
**Choose a template** pop-up in Steps, fills in the steps from a ready-made template
**Before you launch** box (shown as "Fix N things before this can go live" or "N things likely to cost you replies") with a Show/Hide link
**Join a BCA group test** box with **Join this test** and **Leave test** buttons
pages.notes: The On switch only works once a matching account is connected (LinkedIn, email or WhatsApp, depending on the campaign), and it is locked for archived campaigns. The group test box does not show for email campaigns, and the launch check box does not show for archived ones. Campaigns made from a lead magnet open on the lead magnet page instead.}

**Withdraw now** card with a number box and **-** / **+** buttons to pick how many of the oldest to withdraw

List of pending requests showing name, short description and how long ago it was sent
**Withdraw** button on each request in the list, asks you to confirm
**Nothing pending** message when the list is empty

**Copy** next to the page link under the title
